candidates.name: openaddresses/openaddresses
candidates.what_it_holds: CC0 registry of thousands of source configs pointing to government address, cadastral parcel, building-footprint and street-centerline datasets worldwide (heavy US county/city coverage); a batch pipeline resolves them into downloadable files. 3,257 stars, updated 13 Sep 2026.
candidates.why_useful: Fastest index of county/city parcel and address datasets, for cross-referencing STR registry addresses against county parcel/ownership records (absentee-owner / investment-property share by market).

candidates.name: arthur-e/parcel-analysis
candidates.what_it_holds: Scripts converting fixed-width DataQuick/RealtyTrac/CoreLogic county-assessor, deed-sale, tax-assessment and foreclosure record layouts into CSV/PostgreSQL, plus CPI-U inflation adjustment. No data committed (vendor license restriction stated in README).
candidates.why_useful: Working parser/schema for county assessor and deed-sale record formats if the team obtains a free county assessor extract.
candidates.geography: LA MSA, Detroit-Flint-Ann Arbor CSA (example configs)

candidates.name: mbruns13/redfin_housing_data
candidates.what_it_holds: Kaggle '2012-2021 Redfin Dataset' -- monthly market-summary aggregates (median sale price, inventory, new listings, property mix) by US state/county -- joined to Census 2010-2021 population.
candidates.why_useful: Committed county/state monthly housing price and inventory panel 2012-2021; second-home purchase intensity and housing-cost backdrop for STR host economics.

candidates.name: Shanks2121/Redfin-Housing-Data-ETL
candidates.what_it_holds: ETL pipeline pulling and cleaning Redfin's public 'data center' housing-market downloads (weekly/monthly metro median sale price, inventory, days-on-market).
candidates.why_useful: One-command method to keep a current, point-in-time Redfin metro housing panel refreshed.

candidates.name: uiuc-bdeep/Zillow_Housing_Database
candidates.what_it_holds: Pipeline converting Zillow raw housing text-file exports into a PostgreSQL database and CSV/RDS 'hedonics' outputs, with a state/county_state_fips crosswalk.
candidates.why_useful: Reusable FIPS crosswalk and working Zillow-bulk-file pipeline for matching Zillow geography to Inside Airbnb markets.

candidates.name: cermak-petr/actor-zillow-api-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Apify actor extracting home listing data (price, days on market, home facts) from Zillow's internal API by search area. 62 stars, updated 7 Aug 2026.
candidates.why_useful: Actively maintained live pull of Zillow for-sale/list-price data as a housing-cost proxy for STR host acquisition economics by market. Scraping Zillow is a ToS question for a human.

candidates.name: AlexMotz/us-neighborhood-geojson
candidates.what_it_holds: US neighborhood boundaries in GeoJSON, converted from Zillow's archived open-source neighborhood boundary shapefiles.
candidates.why_useful: Offline geography crosswalk to align Inside Airbnb listings or STR-registry addresses to standard neighborhood units without a live Zillow API call.

candidates.name: SirMist/hmda-mortgage-disclosure-data
candidates.what_it_holds: Apify actor pulling HMDA loan-level mortgage origination records -- purpose, occupancy type (primary/second-home/investment), loan amount, census-tract geography.
candidates.why_useful: Isolates second-home and investment-property mortgage origination volume/geography as a loan-level financing-capacity leading indicator for new STR host supply, finer than existing FRED holdings.

candidates.name: sap156/zillow-mcp-server
candidates.what_it_holds: MCP server exposing Zillow real-estate data access as agent tool calls: property search, price/rent estimates, market stats by area. 48 stars, MIT, updated 2 Sep 2026.
candidates.why_useful: Ready-made query interface for ad hoc Zillow price/rent context on specific STR markets.

candidates.name: mhaseeb04/realtor-data-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Realtor.com data-scraping platform (browser extension + authenticated backend) collecting agent and property listing information; updated 6 Sep 2026.
candidates.why_useful: One of the few recently-maintained Realtor.com pulls; a third listing-price source alongside Zillow/Redfin for cross-validation.

candidates.name: WazeDev/WME-GIS-Layers
candidates.what_it_holds: Waze Map Editor plugin overlaying county-published GIS parcel-boundary and address-point layers.
candidates.why_useful: Pointer to county GIS portals publishing parcel-boundary layers, complementing OpenAddresses for parcel-level STR-address matching.

candidates.name: grascovit/airbnb-calculator
candidates.what_it_holds: Client-side Airbnb profitability calculator with user-entered inputs only, no embedded market data or API -- representative of ~10 similar toy repos found this session.
candidates.why_useful: Closes out the 'STR yield calculator with embedded market assumptions' idea as a miss: none of the calculators found carry real market data.

My 10 real-estate-investor-angle ideas (hit/miss):
1. Zillow ZHVI/ZORI/neighborhood-boundary mirrors + scraping/ETL tooling -- HIT (method/pipeline repos, not raw bulk files; Zillow Research CSVs are pulled live by these, not committed).
2. Redfin Data Center weekly/monthly market CSVs (median sale price, inventory, new listings, days-on-market) mirrored/scraped -- HIT, including a committed 2012-2021 county/state monthly Kaggle-derived panel.
3. Realtor.com listing/market-data scrapers -- PARTIAL HIT, scraper tooling only, no clean committed dataset found.
4. County assessor/tax-parcel tooling (DataQuick/RealtyTrac/CoreLogic parsers) and parcel/address source registries (OpenAddresses) -- HIT; no assessor data itself is redistributable (license-restricted per one README) but the registry + parser tooling is a real path to absentee-owner/investment-property cross-referencing by parcel.
5. HMDA loan-level mortgage-origination data acquisition -- HIT (Apify actor); occupancy-type field (second-home/investment) gives a financing-capacity proxy for new STR host supply, finer than existing FRED holdings.
6. Freddie Mac PMMS / historical US mortgage-rate series mirrored as a GitHub dataset -- MISS, came up empty before WebSearch was usable; retry with fresh budget.
7. STR yield/cash-flow calculators with embedded market assumptions (cap rate, expected ADR/occupancy by market) -- MISS, every 'airbnb calculator' repo found (10+) is a toy form with only user-entered inputs, no market data.
8. AirDNA/PriceLabs/Mashvisor-style STR analytics API wrappers with cached market-level data (a free realised-ADR/occupancy proxy, gap #2) -- MISS, not found this session, queries returned empty or hit rate limits before completion; high value if it exists, worth a dedicated follow-up.
9. STR ordinance/registration datasets as open-data client libraries (Socrata/CKAN wrappers keyed to city registries) -- MISS this session (rate-limited before search completed); likely overlaps existing municipal-registry/regulatory-database holdings even if found.
10. Vacation-rental company (Vacasa, Sonder, Vrbo) API-wrapper/investor-data repos with property-count figures as competitor-supply signal -- MISS, not reached before rate limits.

Bonus, surfaced while chasing #4: a Waze Map Editor plugin (WazeDev/WME-GIS-Layers) overlaying county parcel/address-point GIS layers -- confirms county GIS parcel portals are a live open-source integration target.
